ai.title: Apple layoffs: iPhone maker to cut 200 jobs, half of it from a single product division
ai.description: Apple is undertaking significant workforce reductions, impacting over 200 roles within its Siri and Vision Pro divisions. This move, the company's most substantial since early 2024, signals a strategic pivot towards artificial intelligence and the development of new smart glasses, while addressing slower-than-expected adoption of the Vision Pro. The restructuring aims to reallocate resources to AI-powered features and updated technical requirements for Siri, with Apple committed to supporting affected employees through transition.
ai.title_cn: 苹果裁员：iPhone制造商将裁员200人，其中一半来自单一产品部门
ai.description_cn: 苹果正在大幅裁员，影响其Siri和Vision Pro部门的200多个职位。此举是该公司自2024年初以来最重大的举措，标志着该公司战略转向人工智能和新型智能眼镜的开发，同时解决Vision Pro采用慢于预期的问题。此次重组旨在将资源重新分配给人工智能功能和更新Siri的技术要求，苹果致力于通过过渡支持受影响的员工。
